== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Danz Borin (V) (Virtual Block 1) (Errata)]] (<code>1210_6</code>, Virtual Block 1 slip 06), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 1 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB1-06-Danz_Borin.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB1-D-danzborin-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Danz Borin (V) (Virtual Block 1)]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side), official text as of 27 April 2013 ([[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf]]; preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]). The Master List transcription drops icons: the pilot icon (“Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots”) and the [Independent Starship] icon are drawn as on the printed slip.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. May add 1 to Force drains at same Nal Hutta location. Danz is a matching pilot for any [Independent Starship] starship and, while piloting one, may not draw more than one battle destiny here (your battle destinies here may not be canceled or modified by opponent).”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker), STANDARD rev 71: the card's own Virtual Legacy card (same Decipher art, frame, lore, icons, slip number and Virtual Block 1 set mark as the printed card) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
